rationale: Receptor, kinase and transcription-factor activities (E_PGR, S_PGR, S_PKA, S_NR2F2, S_HAND2): entities an agent or a genetic manipulation acts on.
E_IHH, a secreted ligand.
E_LIF, the LIF ligand (proxy: LIF expression or secretion). DTR022 separates it from the pathway node by role and proxy.
E_GP130_STAT3, a pathway activity: 'a pathway state is what an inhibitor acts on'.
E_PC6, an enzyme. Its cleavage product is refused separately.
E_ITGAVB3_5, a receptor. Eligible is not expressive: DTR009 records its conjunct as absorbed, so a veto is structurally near-inert in this model.
Adhesion molecules and processes (E_HBEGF, E_CD98_CD9, E_ANXA2_ACTIN, E_CDH1_APICAL). DTR020 records this label as free text spanning levels, so its two derived members are refused by node.
E_PODXL, a surface protein. The two derived surface states in this role are refused by node.
E_SPP1_EXPR, expression of a ligand: the level of an SPP1 knockdown (PERT-011), distinct from the free-ligand pool.
S_SPP1, stromal SPP1.
S_TAZ_ECM. DTR013: the mechanical readouts are outside the formalism, the mechanical target is not.
X_SPP1_LUMEN_FREE, the free-ligand pool a neutralising antibody acts on.
Composite programs. Vetoing one sets the derived program directly instead of acting on an entity.
Composite latent states (E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE, X_MECHANICAL_PERMISSIVE_ECM).
Measured markers (E_PAEP, S_PRL, S_IGFBP1). Vetoing a readout reads the observation off the intervention; DTR016: do not drug either marker.
S_BMP2. The dictionary leaves it ambiguous, and DTR007 separates BMP2 abundance from BMP pathway activity, which this one node conflates.
Logical aggregates of interface routes, not entities.
E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION, a derived proliferative state.
S_FGF_MITOGENIC, derived as not S_HAND2.
E_KLF12_HIGH, a hand-set free variable; genetic-only, and the pre-registered KLF12 prior activated nothing.
Vetoing a phenotype reads the endpoint off the intervention.
A modelling device the dictionary flags as uncertain, not an entity.
Protocol or environment inputs (O1-O3). Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
Assay-design inputs. Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
External inputs. Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
Pathology inputs. Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
Boundary inputs. Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
Legacy intervention markers (v0.5.2 and earlier). Self-loops, so also refused mechanically.
A cleavage product: you perturb the protease. LIT-PC6-002 dissociates product from enzyme.
The substrate state, derived as not E_PC6; the product/enzyme argument applies.
A glycoform reachable only via machinery absent from the model.
The exact complement of E_MUC1_SLEX. Abundance and glycoform can reverse the interpretation, so one veto would mean neither MUC1 knockdown nor deglycosylation.
